versions.changelog: The API key is now optional to load this skill; with no key, a pointer leads to a temporary free key with no signup and a link the user opens to keep it.

Acceleration on percent-unit series (growth rates, margins) is now the difference of two pp changes, not a relative change of a percentage. Quarterly series whose newest close is more than about 200 days old are flagged BEHIND, with guidance to present them as the latest available rather than the latest reported.

First release: company KPI series (segment revenue, deliveries, subscribers, non-GAAP metrics) with fiscal-period-safe q/q and y/y deltas, discovery workflow, and a stdlib table helper with 62 fixtures.
